scope: Source evidence only; no generation, import, production edits or fidelity certification.

incarnation.game: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
excluded: MGSV mods, cosplay, fanart and generated project imagery

source_provenance_note: Steam app287700 is the official original TPP store gallery; saved page links the full1920x1080 screenshots. Game-Art-HQ places its linked PNG renders under the heading Official Game Art like concept art,promotional Illustrations and renders of Quiet from Metal Gear Solid. This is a secondary attribution; original publisher asset URL was not recovered, so those renders are supplementary rather than certified primary. Filenames containing official do not certify origin.

physical_inspection.method: Actual unmodified local full Steam20/21 JPEG and front/back PNG viewed through tools.view_image by both assigned source agent and coordinating agent.
physical_inspection.steam20: 1920x1080 original gameplay: default Quiet kneels and shoulders a scoped long-barrel conventional sniper rifle; black top, bare shoulders/torso, olive harness, torn dark tights, tied brown hair. Anatomical LEFT arm wears long glossy black protection/sleeve; RIGHT forearm lacks it.
physical_inspection.steam21: 1920x1080 original game scene; Quiet stands in rear, too blurred for precise face/glove/weapon identification. Default exposed torso and harness silhouette contextual only.
physical_inspection.front_back_renders: Secondary mirrored raster renders support front/back costume, ponytail, harness, boots, LEFT long black sleeve, RIGHT thigh holster/straps, LEFT hip pouch. Fine finger coverage uncertain.

observed_identity_costume.hair: Brown hair tied into low ponytail with side fringe and loose face strands; not long loose hair.
observed_identity_costume.face: Adult woman; precise eye color is not certified from screenshots.
observed_identity_costume.outfit: Dark bikini-style top tied at front, dark shorts, exposed torso and neckline, torn dark hosiery/pantyhose, olive harness/webbing and belt. No closed tactical collar.
observed_identity_costume.anatomical_left: Long glossy black arm sleeve/protection extending to elbow/upper arm; side confirmed from front/back plus game shot. Olive pouch/satchel at left hip in supplemental render.
observed_identity_costume.anatomical_right: Short olive glove visible, bare forearm without long black sleeve; thigh holster and olive retaining straps on RIGHT thigh in supplementary renders.
observed_identity_costume.glove_finger_coverage: Unresolved: small raster and occlusion do not securely establish full versus fingerless coverage.
observed_identity_costume.boots: Supplemental renders show dark laced boots with ankle/lower-shin cuff; primary screenshot does not provide a clean full-body view.
observed_identity_costume.equipment_limits: Exact pouch count, underlying materials, hardware hidden by body or rifle, and all-side topology are not certified.

weapon_evidence.category: Conventional scoped sniper rifle, long exposed barrel, visible bolt/receiver and supporting hand.
weapon_evidence.exact_models: UNRESOLVED: no exact Wicked Butterfly/Guilty Butterfly/Sinful Butterfly alias or upgrade proven from selected image alone. Receiver/scope/barrel shape visible, internal operation and ammunition unverified.
weapon_evidence.hud_caveat: AM MRS-4 RIFLE M3 /31-179 in Steam20 is the player Venom Snake weapon HUD. It does not identify Quiet’s rifle.
weapon_evidence.rifle_handedness: Shouldered aiming posture visible; this still does not establish every animation or universal dominant hand.

raw_profile_comparison.finding: Direct default outfit contradiction: exposed neckline/top in primary screenshot; no closed tactical collar.
Underspecified: tied brown ponytail and face fringe, not loose long hair.
Broad enums and booleans do not encode the distinctive exposed-torso costume, torn hosiery and left/right arm asymmetry. Exact materials,3pouch count,pads and finger coverage are unproven.
Sniper category agrees; exact aliases, ammo type, tranquilizer effect, laser telegraph and damage/timings are not proven by stills.
Unsupported by source set and inconsistent with snapshot basis which calls the movement parasite-derived. No psychic power is established by these stills.
No railgun or energy beam evidence. Selected screenshot shows conventional sniper hardware. Tag alone is an internal versus adaptation, not an original-game weapon specification.
Snapshot declares timings, damage, costs, chains and limits created for balancing. Precision bonus,5round resource,blink displacement,mark and reload timings are not original-game certified.

All four finishers canonical=false/evidence=adaptation. Names A Quiet Exit,Butterfly Mark,Ricochet Song,Silent Fulton and phase sequences/timings are not original game certification; Silent Fulton name does not prove independent extraction ability.
